harness: GPT-6 Astra v4.0.0 by inherited user preference

claims.title: Near-annihilator certified phi degree reduction
assumptions: q monic degree d with d real nodes in [-1,1], repetitions interpreted as Hermite multiplicities
claims.complexity: r*(d-1) operator products for r verified input channels; O(r*n+d) extra storage under streaming evaluation, with scalar setup charged separately
claims.finite_precision: outward scalar coefficient enclosure + norm(v)*sum coefficient radii + sum local Horner defect norms + input factorization residual + output assembly rounding
claims.negative_boundary: Not valid from real eigenvalues alone for nonnormal X; not an ODE global-error theorem

claims.title: Laguerre quotient compilation
assumptions: stored degree-m Laguerre coefficients with exact target identity
near_bound uses Hermitian X with spectrum in [-1,1], or a separate certificate norm(a_j(X))<=A_j; exact quotient identity does not need Hermitian X
claims.conclusion: Compile three-term recurrence modulo q in O(m*d) scalar arithmetic; exact q(X)=0 preserves polynomial action; vector application costs d-1 products
claims.finite_precision: Outward scalar compilation enclosure and new short vector evaluation certificate replace, rather than silently reuse, original degree-m recurrence defects
claims.negative_boundary: O(m*d) counts scalar arithmetic, not bounded bit complexity; Chebyshev/Leja/Taylor may use the same reduction; no Laguerre dominance claim

claims.title: Nonnormal finite jet shifted inverse
claims.near_bound: If eta=(abs(a)/abs(b))^d*norm(N^d)<1, inverse norm <= norm(R)/(1-eta) and truncation norm <= norm(R)*eta/(1-eta)
claims.finite_precision: Outward gain plus exact-current-target residual and assembly/JVP rounding; nilpotence binding from full structure, not sampled vectors
claims.negative_boundary: Large nonnormal gain may prevent useful binary64 accuracy; direct triangular or structured solve can be cheaper

claims.title: Strict total modeled-work improvement gate
assumptions: common constant modeled per-application C_X for both paths; if distinct old/new cost bounds are used replace saved-work RHS by r*m*C_old_lower-r*(d-1)*C_new_upper
setup, scalar, vector, certificate, dispatch, failure and fallback costs have stated upper bounds
M reuse count is guaranteed or realized
claims.conclusion: S_alg/M+S_coeff+V_new+F_new < r*(m-d+1)*C_X guarantees new total modeled work below baseline operator-only lower bound
claims.negative_boundary: No wall-time conclusion without matched measurement; no omitted setup or speculative amortization
